name: AI-Powered Cybersecurity
description: Artificial intelligence is transforming cybersecurity with automated threat detection, behavioral analysis, and predictive defense. Vendors are integrating machine learning for real-time anomaly detection and response. The shift toward AI-native security platforms is accelerating as enterprises seek to reduce human analyst workload and improve detection accuracy.

name: Sustainable Defense Tech
description: Defense contractors and startups are increasingly focusing on sustainable and eco-friendly technologies. This includes electric propulsion for drones, biodegradable materials, and energy-efficient computing for edge deployment. Regulatory pressure and corporate ESG goals are driving adoption.

name: Edge Computing for Battlefields
description: Edge computing enables real-time processing of sensor data, autonomous decision-making, and reduced latency in contested environments. Vendors are developing rugged, low-power hardware and distributed software architectures for military applications.

name: Resilient Supply Chain Platforms
description: Post-pandemic supply chain disruptions have accelerated demand for visibility, redundancy, and predictive analytics. Startups are building platforms that combine IoT, blockchain, and AI to create more resilient defense and dual-use supply chains.

name: Autonomous Swarm Systems
description: Coordinated autonomous swarms of drones, ground robots, and maritime vessels are moving from research to deployment. Key developments include decentralized coordination, human-swarm interfaces, and integration with existing command systems.

name: Quantum-Resistant Encryption
description: As quantum computing advances, the defense sector is prioritizing post-quantum cryptography. Vendors are developing and certifying algorithms that resist future quantum attacks while maintaining compatibility with current infrastructure.
